info.title: Info & privacy
info.p1: Turnotto works entirely in your browser. It has no account, no server and no database of its own.
info.p2: The data you enter (names, hours, absences, plans) is stored only on your device, in the browser's local storage, and in the files you choose to save.
info.p3: We do not collect, transmit, sell or share personal data. No analytics, no advertising, no cookies, no tracking.
info.p4: The app is hosted on GitHub Pages: GitHub may record technical data such as your IP address, according to its own privacy statement. Fonts and all other files are served from the same site.
info.p5: You can delete all data at any time from Rules → Delete everything, or by clearing your browser data.
info.p6: If you enter other people's data, you are responsible for doing so in compliance with the law that applies to you (for example the GDPR).
info.d1: Turnotto is a free, amateur utility, provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind.
info.d2: Generated plans are only suggestions: always check that they comply with the contracts, laws and company rules that apply to you.
info.d3: The authors accept no liability for any damage, loss of data or consequence arising from its use.
info.d4: Make regular backups: data stored in the browser can be lost.
